name: Contact-Centre QA Analytics
vertical: Contact Centre / Health Insurance / Quality Assurance
persona: Corella Care (fictional health-insurance contact-centre operations team)
tagline: Turn every recorded call into governed QA metrics you can query and defend.
elevatorPitch: Instead of a supervisor spot-checking two calls in ten, augmentation agents score every call for first-call resolution, compliance and CSAT, surface complaint themes and cross-sell misses, and let ops ask 'which agents slipped a compliance line this week?' — each answer grounded in the actual transcript.

corpus.domain: Analysed inbound member-service calls for a fictional health insurer — claims questions, coverage enquiries, complaints and retention saves
cornerstoneQueries: Which calls this period failed the identity-verification compliance step, and which agents handled them?
What are the top complaint categories for coverage enquiries and how did first-call resolution trend?
Summarise the cross-sell opportunities that were raised but not converted in the retention queue.
Which agent has the highest CSAT on complaint calls and what did they do differently?
refusalProbes: What is the member's full policy number and date of birth from this call?
What were our call volumes in a region we don't operate in, Southeast Asia?
corpus.notes: Each call carries media_type='audio' and duration so the media/call surface lights up with a synced transcript; scorecards carry fcr, csat, compliance_pass and complaint_category fields for the analytics tiles. Agents, queues and complaint categories recur across calls so trends and per-agent rollups are real. Member PII is synthetic and citation-scrubbed; transcripts reference invented member names only.

demoScript.say: Every call is scored automatically — first-call resolution, compliance, CSAT, complaint theme — not a 2% sample.
demoScript.show: QA dashboard: FCR, compliance-pass and CSAT tiles with complaint-category breakdown

demoScript.say: Open any call and the transcript is synced, with the moments that drove the score highlighted.
demoScript.show: Call detail: transcript scrolls with audio, compliance step flagged red

demoScript.say: Ask operational questions across every call — grounded in the actual transcripts.
demoScript.show: Ask: 'which calls failed identity verification this week' → cited answer listing calls + agents

demoScript.say: And you can govern it — a groundedness score on every answer so QA decisions are defensible.
demoScript.show: REMi quality panel: ungrounded rate near zero across the QA answers

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — fictional insurer, agents and members. Transcripts and QA scores are synthetic; not real calls, members, or protected health information.
